accordion.zh-CN: 手风琴模式，每次只展开一个面板。
accordion.en-US: Accordion mode, only one panel is expanded at a time.

activeKey.zh-CN: 受控属性，当前展开面板的 key；`null` 与空字符串表示全部收起。
activeKey.en-US: Controlled property, key of the currently expanded panel; `null` and the empty string mean all panels are collapsed.

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

clickHeaderToExpand.zh-CN: 点击面板头整行展开收起；为 `false` 时只响应切换按钮和箭头。
clickHeaderToExpand.en-US: Clicking anywhere in the header row toggles the panel; when `false` only the toggle button and the arrow respond.

collapseIcon.zh-CN: 面板展开时显示的图标，传入 ReactNode；未传时为 `IconChevronUp`，传入 `null` 不显示图标。
collapseIcon.en-US: Icon shown while a panel is expanded, given as a ReactNode; `IconChevronUp` when omitted, and `null` shows no icon.

defaultActiveKey.en-US: Key of the panel expanded initially.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 面板收起时显示的图标，传入 ReactNode；未传时为 `IconChevronDown`，传入 `null` 不显示图标。
expandIcon.en-US: Icon shown while a panel is collapsed, given as a ReactNode; `IconChevronDown` when omitted, and `null` shows no icon.

expandIconPosition.en-US: Position of the expand icon: `left` or `right`.

keepDOM.zh-CN: 是否保留隐藏面板的 DOM 树，默认销毁；未传时依次读 Collapse、Collapsible 的全局默认值。
keepDOM.en-US: Whether to keep the DOM tree of hidden panels; destroyed by default. When omitted it reads the global default of Collapse, then that of Collapsible.

lazyRender.zh-CN: 配合 `keepDOM` 使用，为 `true` 时面板展开前不渲染内容。
lazyRender.en-US: Used with `keepDOM`; when `true`, panel content is not rendered until the panel is first expanded.

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启动画，默认开启；未传时依次读 Collapse、Collapsible 的全局默认值。
motion.en-US: Whether to enable the animation; enabled by default. When omitted it reads the global default of Collapse, then that of Collapsible.

onChange.zh-CN: 切换面板时调用，参数为展开面板的 key 数组与原生 MouseEvent（键盘操作经原生按钮同样是 click）。
onChange.en-US: Called when a panel is toggled, with the array of expanded keys and the native MouseEvent (keyboard use also produces a click through the native button).

className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

extra.zh-CN: 面板头右侧的辅助内容，位于切换按钮之外，可以放按钮、输入框等控件。
extra.en-US: Auxiliary content on the right of the panel header, outside the toggle button; may hold buttons, inputs and other controls.

header.zh-CN: 面板头内容，渲染在切换按钮内，不能包含交互元素。
header.en-US: Panel header content, rendered inside the toggle button; must not contain interactive elements.

itemKey.zh-CN: 必填且唯一，用于匹配 `activeKey` 与 `defaultActiveKey`。
itemKey.en-US: Required and unique, matched against `activeKey` and `defaultActiveKey`.

onMotionEnd.zh-CN: 展开或收起动画结束时调用。
onMotionEnd.en-US: Called when the expand or collapse animation ends.

showArrow.en-US: Whether to show the arrow icon.
